fields.summary_ko.0: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) trades at a P/E of 42.8x (versus 21.9x for the S&P 500), and to sustain current price levels requires 7.6% annual revenue growth.
fields.summary_ko.1: JNJ's 12-month revenue growth rate was 7.8%, current market cap is $689 billion, and estimated net profit margin is 25.2%.
fields.summary_ko.2: Management guided 2026 revenue to approximately $101 billion (+6.9%), with adjusted EPS expected to grow approximately 2.9%, or about 9% excluding M&A.
